gate_reuse: six Phase17 successful gates, no new gates or reference rendering

reference.distance_interpretation: robot center to box/wall surface; not footprint; same for inner and outer walls
reference.algorithm: 2cm clearance-weighted A*: edge_length*(1+(.25/clearance)^2); >=.25m first, then only opposing-surface centerlines of sub-.5m passages if disconnected; 20 local clearance-preserving smoothing passes; no parameter tuning or navigation retry
reference.narrow_fallback: local nearest two opposing surfaces dot<=-.9, separation<.5m, one-cell medial band projected to exact surface midpoint; physical footprint margin >=.02m
reference.reference_length_definition: length of frozen smoothed clearance-weighted geometric route; shortest-grid length retained separately

oracle_scope: evaluation only; methods use depth snapshots and exact simulator odometry (no odometry error)

rtc.label: RTC hard-masking ablation (DDPM adaptation)
rtc.target: nomad_phase8.request.rtc_target unchanged; active OLD path at observation snapshot A
rtc.post_generation: all eight metric XY samples -> common observation-anchored FRESHEST-SAFE selection at B
rtc.d_zero: unchanged: soft guidance when W nonzero, normal DDPM when W zero; no special replacement

recovery.trigger: two consecutive STOP_WAIT FRESH decisions AND actual v<.01 at control tick; resets after recovery
recovery.rotation_finish: 30deg exactly; final 72Hz interval shortened angular command only; unchanged AngularPlant used
recovery.during_rotation: RGB/inference continue; FRESH marked deferred; pending Graph results discarded, no path tracking
recovery.after_rotation: wait for next actual FRESH switch, normal selection; existing timeout clock unchanged

fallback.clock: unchanged NoMaD latest release validity; retained path/source id explicitly logged

te_keep_rule: ALL_UNSAFE only: add no new chunk; expire normally; evaluate each valid component suffix with latest depth >=.025m and remaining >=.25m; discard failed components; retain chronological order and renormalize exp(-.5k); KEEP_ACTIVE iff at least one survivor, otherwise STOP_WAIT; record safety-removal and expiry counts separately

metrics.checkpoint: first saved72Hz pose meeting scene.checkpoint axis/threshold; no imputation
metrics.minimum_oracle_clearance: min exact swept footprint clearance across scene boxes AND outer walls; box-only minimum additionally reported
metrics.safety_failure: geometric overlap OR corridor intrusion; count each run once
metrics.inference: all inference inputs including initialization; run median/p95 and pooled method distribution
metrics.rtc_prefix: all samples and all d-prefix waypoints, norm(metric-target_local_xy), same Phase12 rtc_prefix_error definition

statistics.resampling: paired seed clusters across scenes; within each draw sum differences/count matched pairs
statistics.composite: CONFIRMED iff all3 flags true; PARTIAL iff exactly2; NOT_CONFIRMED otherwise; overall ALL_CONFIRMED only if all3 comparisons CONFIRMED
statistics.S1: CLR vs GRAPH-depth: clearance paired CI lower>0 => CLEARANCE_LARGER; checkpoint and recovery/STOP_WAIT counts
statistics.S2: CLR vs SAFE: checkpoint paired difference and success counts
statistics.S3: scene-specific descriptive counts and pair estimates; no new scene-specific primary decision
statistics.technical_failure_rule_note: Conservative default disclosed before execution; technical failures are neither collisions nor successes; H1 still uses observed valid checkpoint pairs.

rtc_replay.selection: lowest Phase12 RTC-hard seed index, first request with d>0

runtime_isolation: AST redirects only Phase17 config/execution imports after unchanged SimulationApp initialization; no scientific imports before Kit

preflight_startup_failure.fix: defer config/executor SciPy imports until protected SimulationApp startup; method constants and decision rules unchanged
preflight_startup_failure.second_launch: explicitly authorized by user; same CL SAFE+RTC-hard 30s smoke
